import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, os
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
D='/tmp/g'; os.makedirs(D,exist_ok=True)
OUT='/agent/jobs/7b68df0a-e64f-459f-b8e1-5042bbc40de7/provenance'
for pid in ['2DC1','1J5P']:
    open(f'{D}/{pid}.pdb','w').write(S.get(f"https://files.rcsb.org/download/{pid}.pdb",timeout=120).text)
open(f'{D}/AF.pdb','w').write(S.get("https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-A6ND91-F1-model_v6.pdb",timeout=120).text)
aa3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H','ILE':'I',
     'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V','MSE':'M'}
def parse(p):
    o=[]
    for l in open(p):
        if l.startswith(('ATOM','HETATM')):
            o.append(dict(rec=l[:6].strip(),name=l[12:16].strip(),res=l[17:20].strip(),ch=l[21],
              num=int(l[22:26]),xyz=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])]),
              el=(l[76:78].strip() or l[12:16].strip()[0])))
    return o
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc,qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0);H=(P-pc).T@(Q-qc);U,Sv,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))])@U.T;return R,qc-R@pc
def apl(R,t,X): return (R@X.T).T+t
at_af=parse(f'{D}/AF.pdb'); at_2=parse(f'{D}/2DC1.pdb'); at_1=parse(f'{D}/1J5P.pdb')
eq=[(7,13),(8,14),(9,15),(10,16),(11,17),(31,41),(32,42),(57,74),(58,75),(59,76),(62,79),(66,83),
    (80,96),(81,97),(110,126),(111,127),(162,192),(163,193),(215,256),(219,260),(134,152),(160,190),
    (161,191),(187,223),(189,225),(214,255),(216,257)]
c2={a['num']:a['xyz'] for a in at_2 if a['rec']=='ATOM' and a['name']=='CA' and a['ch']=='A'}
cH={a['num']:a['xyz'] for a in at_af if a['rec']=='ATOM' and a['name']=='CA'}
R,t=kabsch(np.array([c2[i] for i,j in eq]),np.array([cH[j] for i,j in eq]))
def nadat(a,ch='A'): return {x['name']:x['xyz'] for x in a if x['res']=='NAD' and x['ch']==ch}
n2=nadat(at_2); n1=nadat(at_1)
C2h=apl(R,t,n2['C2B'][None])[0]; O2h=apl(R,t,n2['O2B'][None])[0]; C1h=apl(R,t,n2['C1B'][None])[0]
def hv(a,ch=None): return [x for x in a if x['el']!='H' and x['res'] not in ('HOH','NAD','CIT') and (ch is None or x['ch']==ch)]
g=np.arange(-3.4,3.41,0.45); G0=np.array(np.meshgrid(g,g,g)).reshape(3,-1).T; G0=G0[np.linalg.norm(G0,axis=1)<=3.4]
def scan(C2,O2,C1,atoms):
    X=np.array([a['xyz'] for a in atoms]); k=np.linalg.norm(X-O2,axis=1)<14; atoms=[a for a,kk in zip(atoms,k) if kk]; X=X[k]
    ax=(O2-C2); ax/=np.linalg.norm(ax); ref=C1-C2; pp=ref-np.dot(ref,ax)*ax; pp/=np.linalg.norm(pp); p2=np.cross(ax,pp)
    ang=np.deg2rad(60); out=[]
    for th in np.linspace(0,2*np.pi,36,endpoint=False):
        d=np.cos(ang)*ax+np.sin(ang)*(np.cos(th)*pp+np.sin(th)*p2); P=O2+1.61*d
        dd=np.linalg.norm(X-P,axis=1); i=int(dd.argmin())
        free=float((np.linalg.norm((G0+P)[:,None,:]-X[None,:,:],axis=2).min(1)>3.0).mean())
        out.append(dict(theta=np.rad2deg(th),min_dist=float(dd.min()),free=free,clash=int((dd<3.0).sum()),
                        near=aa3.get(atoms[i]['res'],'X')+str(atoms[i]['num'])))
    return pd.DataFrame(out)
ph=scan(C2h,O2h,C1h,hv(at_af)); p2=scan(n2['C2B'],n2['O2B'],n2['C1B'],hv(at_2,'A')); p1=scan(n1['C2B'],n1['O2B'],n1['C1B'],hv(at_1,'A'))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15,4.6))
col={'human ASPDH (AlphaFold)':'#2ca02c','A. fulgidus 2DC1':'#1f77b4','T. maritima 1J5P':'#9467bd'}
ax=axes[0]
for lab,p in [('human ASPDH (AlphaFold)',ph),('A. fulgidus 2DC1',p2),('T. maritima 1J5P',p1)]:
    ax.plot(p.theta,p.min_dist,'o-',ms=4,color=col[lab],label=lab)
ax.axhline(3.0,ls='--',color='r',lw=1.2); ax.text(2,3.06,'clash threshold 3.0 A',color='r',fontsize=8)
ax.set_xlabel("rotation about the C2'-O2' bond (degrees)")
ax.set_ylabel("closest protein heavy atom to the modelled 2'-P (A)")
ax.set_title("A. Room for a 2'-phosphate at the adenosine ribose",fontsize=10,loc='left')
ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc='lower right')

ax=axes[1]
labs=['human\nASPDH','A. fulgidus\n2DC1','T. maritima\n1J5P']
nfree=[int((p.clash==0).sum()) for p in [ph,p2,p1]]
bars=ax.bar(labs,nfree,color=[col['human ASPDH (AlphaFold)'],col['A. fulgidus 2DC1'],col['T. maritima 1J5P']])
for b,p in zip(bars,[ph,p2,p1]):
    best=p.sort_values(['free','min_dist'],ascending=False).iloc[0]
    ax.text(b.get_x()+b.get_width()/2,b.get_height()+0.5,f"best {best.min_dist:.2f} A",ha='center',fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylim(0,19); ax.set_ylabel('rotamers out of 36 with no clash')
ax.set_title("B. The NAD-specific enzymes block the 2' position",fontsize=10,loc='left')
ax.text(0.02,0.92,"limiting residue across rotamers:\nhuman N41 (Asn)   2DC1 D31 (Asp)   1J5P D28/I30",
        transform=ax.transAxes,fontsize=8,va='top')

ax=axes[2]; ax.axis('off')
ax.text(0,1,"C. 2' site composition\n\n"
 "human ASPDH   N41 3.2 A, R42 4.3, D43 4.6, R46 4.7\n"
 "A. fulgidus   D31 2.8 A, V32 3.5, R33 4.5\n"
 "T. maritima   D28 2.8 A, I30 3.2, R29 4.1\n\n"
 "The prokaryotic Asp carboxylate sits directly on the\n"
 "2'-OH and is the atom that blocks a phosphate there.\n"
 "In human ASPDH that position is Asn41, which\n"
 "hydrogen bonds to the 2'-OH without charge repulsion,\n"
 "and two arginines (R42, R46) flank the site.\n\n"
 "Mouse ASPDH (Q9DCQ2, the protein used for the\n"
 "NAADP ITC in PMID 35841763) is 88.3% identical to\n"
 "human and matches at all 28 mapped pocket positions,\n"
 "so that binding result transfers to human.\n\n"
 "Rigid-protein calculation: side chains cannot relax.",
 va='top',fontsize=8.8)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
